about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a world where hope battles against the abyss of catastrophe, and discover a story that could change the fate of the main character.
Explore the post-Soviet space, which has turned into a single gloomy place where anomalies violate the laws of physics and reality.|
The main character, Voila, a stalker with a difficult fate, seeks to unravel the mystery of his wife's disappearance during the Cataclysm.

Gather clues, explore the dark corners of new lands, and uncover mysteries lost among the ruins. Here, in the heart of an abandoned world, you will not only find the answer to the fate of Voyla's wife, but also the way to save other people from the creatures of the Cataclysm.

«Burned One» — not just a game, but an exploration of the human soul on the brink of survival. In this world full of danger and hope, you will learn to cherish every moment and never lose faith in the possibility of salvation.

Step into the dark corridors of the post-apocalypse and find out if Voyla will become a guide to the New World...
...or just another shadow in the ashes of the old...



Every step in the New World could be your last. Keep an eye on your surroundings and react as quickly as possible. But... don't make a mistake.
You don't want to end up right in the middle of the «Collapse»...



There is no black and white in this world. Your decisions affect your relationships with people, and in the future — with factions. One wrong move, and the game will end differently than you expected.
Sometimes helping — means putting yourself in danger.
Betraying — means surviving.
And survival — not always a reward.

Every area of the Wastelands holds fragments of the past — diaries, audio recordings, scraps of maps. Collect them to piece together the fate of those who disappeared and uncover what really happened to Voyla's wife.
But some truths are better left buried beneath the ruins...
